prompt: Here's our current GitHub Actions CI workflow — `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. Right now every PR takes about 25 minutes end-to-end, and because lint runs dead last, the single most common failure (a lint error) doesn't show up until roughly 24 minutes in. We're also only testing against one Node version. Walk me through how you'd redesign this file to cut wall-clock time and get feedback back to the developer faster, without losing any of the coverage we currently have. What would you change, why, and how would you verify the improvement actually worked?
